title: POV: You Passed the Funded Challenge… Then Blew the Payout Account
description: That moment when you finally pass the funded challenge — then lose it all on the live account. Sound familiar? Here's the one thing the R2F Trading system teaches that changes everything. #ICTTrading #FundedTrader #OrderBlocks #SmartMoneyConcepts #R2FTrading
script: You just passed the funded challenge. Green across the board. Then day ONE of the live payout account — you blow 6% in a single session. Same strategy. Same pair. Same setup. So why did it work in the challenge… and fail the moment real money hit? Here's the truth nobody talks about. Your mindset shifts when it's real. You chase. You move stops. You overtrade the first liquidity sweep you see. Smart money doesn't care that you passed. Price still sweeps liquidity first. The order block is still there. But you entered early — before confirmation. The R2F Trading system teaches ONE rule for live accounts: never enter before the FVG fills. 73% of blown payouts happen at unconfirmed entries. Wait for the sweep. Wait for the shift. Wait for the FVG. Three confirmations. Then execute. That patience is what separates funded traders who keep accounts from those who don't. Follow R2F Trading. We post ICT setups and funded trader strategies every single day. Link in bio at r2ftrading.com.
